showReport: Only Rollstack's MCP server has it, and the node calls Rollstack's REST API: it opens a report viewer in clients that can show one. getReport, getReportContent and getReportSlideImages answer the same report.
showTemplates: Only Rollstack's MCP server has it, and the node calls Rollstack's REST API: it opens a template picker in clients that can show one. listTemplates answers the same templates.
submitFeedback: Only Rollstack's MCP server has it, and the node calls Rollstack's REST API: it sends Rollstack feedback about its MCP tools.
getTemplatePickerCovers: Called only by the template picker that showTemplates opens in clients that can show it. listTemplates answers the templates in n8n.
getReportMessageProgress: Called only by the progress view that sendReportMessage opens in clients that can show it. getReportMessage answers the same progress.
getReportViewerSlideImages: Called only by the report viewer that showReport opens in clients that can show it. getReportSlideImages renders the same slides.
confirmAction: Called only by the confirmation card Rollstack shows before a call from an AI client that emails people or deletes reports, with a token only that card has. With an API key, Rollstack's REST API runs such a call without one.
